metadata.notes: Conservative draft. Calibrated against existing curated tiers (Garchomp=S, Tyranitar=A, Mega Gengar=A, Mega Lopunny=B, Mega Pidgeot=C, Eeveelutions=C). Pokebase 'popular' mons trend B/A. PC-original Megas default to B if strong typing/ability, C otherwise. Default Untiered when genuinely unsure.

reasoning.aerodactyl-mega: Mega Aerodactyl: pokebase popular list; Tough Claws + 150 Speed makes it a known fan-game sweeper. Base Aerodactyl already S.
reasoning.tyranitar-mega: Mega TTar: Sand Stream + 164 Atk and bulk; base Tyranitar already A. Mega is the strongest sand-team anchor.
reasoning.garchomp-mega: Mega Garchomp: Sand Force + bulk over base; base Garchomp already S. Mega used as bulky physical sweeper.
reasoning.dragonite-mega: Mega Dragonite: pokebase popular. Multiscale + DDance, classic boosting sweeper.
reasoning.scizor: Bullet Punch priority core; pokebase popular. Universal Steel-type pivot.
reasoning.gyarados: Pokebase popular. Intimidate + DDance is meta-defining even without Mega Stone.
reasoning.greninja-mega: Pokebase popular. Protean + Mega boost = fan-game powerhouse.
reasoning.charizard-mega-x: Pokebase popular. Tough Claws Dragon Dance is a classic sweeper.
reasoning.charizard-mega-y: Pokebase popular. Drought + sun team enabler with 159 SpA.
reasoning.gallade: Pokebase popular. Sharpness + Close Combat / Sacred Sword in current meta.
reasoning.gardevoir: Pokebase popular. Pixilate Hyper Voice doubles spam (base, not Mega which is already A).
reasoning.venusaur: Pokebase popular. Sleep Powder + Chlorophyll sun sweeper. Base Mega Venusaur already B.
reasoning.clefable-mega: Pokebase popular. PC-original Mega; Magic Guard + boosted stats.
reasoning.clefable: Magic Guard Life Orb / Calm Mind set is a top wallbreaker in most formats.
reasoning.kommo-o: Pokebase popular. Clangorous Soul threat with Bulletproof/Soundproof.
reasoning.lucario: Pokebase popular. Justified + priority Close Combat / Bullet Punch. (Mega already B.)
reasoning.hydrapple: Top Gen 9 special wall with Fickle Beam / Earth Power; rising meta pick.
reasoning.froslass-mega: Pokebase popular. Spikes / Taunt / Destiny Bond support specialist.
reasoning.zoroark-hisui: Pokebase popular. Ghost/Normal Illusion is a unique disruptor with Bitter Malice.
reasoning.delphox-mega: Pokebase popular. PC-original Mega Fire/Psychic special attacker.
reasoning.gengar: Pokebase popular base form (Mega Gengar already A). Sub/Disable + special attacks.
reasoning.ampharos-mega: Mold Breaker + Dragon/Electric typing; underrated wallbreaker.
reasoning.azumarill: Huge Power + Belly Drum / Aqua Jet; tournament-proven in Reg formats.
reasoning.rotom-heat: Top Fire/Electric pivot for sun + Trick Room teams.
reasoning.sableye: Pokebase popular. Prankster Will-O-Wisp / Recover / Foul Play utility.
reasoning.feraligatr-mega: PC-original Mega. Strong Jaw / Sheer Force DD sweeper.
reasoning.samurott-hisui: Sharpness Ceaseless Edge + Razor Shell; Reg-format physical attacker.
reasoning.kangaskhan: Pokebase popular. Even base (Mega already B) sees use with Scrappy / Sucker Punch.
